text:
Maria (Support): Heads up — Novi Labs (acct: novi-prod) is hitting sustained queueing in us-west-2 on Dedicated. They're getting 429s with 'QuotaExceeded: admission_control' and tail latency is spiking. They need a short-term override for a demo tomorrow morning.

Jonas (SRE): Can you paste the error snippet and their model + concurrency? Also are they on a reserved pool or shared?

Maria (Support): Error from their client: `HTTP 429 QuotaExceeded: admission_control: capacity=0.82 threshold=0.75`
Model: redwood/open-8b-quant, concurrency ~18 steady, burst to 35. They're on a small reserved pool (2 x A10g) + shared fallback.

Priya (Eng Oncall): us-west-2 reserved pool is at ~95% due to rolling nodes (maintenance). Shared pool is currently constrained. Suggest options: 1) temporary reserved GPU bump, 2) enable cross-region fallback to us-west-1, 3) apply admission_control soft-throttle to smooth bursts. Which does Sales prefer for a customer demo?

Evan (Sales): For demo we can do temporary capacity guarantee. Novi asked for enough to support 30 concurrent low-latency streams for 6 hours. Estimate: +3 A10g for 12h would cover it. Can finance ok immediate short-term charge?

Provisioning Bot: [automated] Current autoscaler limits: pool-reserved-usw2 max_nodes=4, current_nodes=4, scale_up blocked by quota in account redwood-prod-usw2. Request ID: prov-78321.

Jonas (SRE): If autoscaler blocked by quota, manual override needed from capacity team or cloud quota increase. Short-term we can: a) reduce concurrency per client with admission_control, b) route lower-priority traffic to shared best-effort, c) enable prefix KV cache to cut token cost. Quick snippet to soften admission control:
```
admission_control:
  max_concurrent_per_customer: 20  # lower from 35
  token_rate_limit: 250000  # tokens/sec
  burst_window_ms: 3000
```

Maria (Support): Sent the error + request to Novi to confirm they authorize charges. Also asked if they'd accept region fallback if we can't get GPUs.

Novi (customer, via email): Region fallback OK but demo latency must stay < 200ms. Prefer dedicated in us-west-2 if possible.

Priya (Eng Oncall): us-west-1 latency to their testers is ~120-150ms (measured). That's within acceptable. But for on-the-fly fix, I can flip traffic to us-west-1 for their demo and put admission_control in place for other tenants. Need SRE/infra thumbs.

Jonas (SRE): I'm fine with temporary cross-region route + apply soft admission_control. That avoids billing churn. If Sales seals payment for +3 GPUs, we can also provision but might not be ready before demo. Manual node provisioning ETA ~3-4 hours if quota is granted now.

Evan (Sales): I'll confirm with Novi on the preference. If they want guaranteed GPUs we'll request an override now — please flag priority.

Maria (Support): Filed a priority override request with infra: ticket INF-2026-571 (include customer acct, requested +3 A10g for 12h, start 2026-03-19 09:00 PDT). Included logs and latency SLO.

ThetaBot: :warning: Cluster us-west-2 average GPU utilization = 93% (5-min), admission queue length = 18. Risk: increased tail latency if we accept more load.

Jonas (SRE): Action plan agreed: 1) Put admission_control soft caps for Novi and other medium tenants (apply config above) — immediate (1-2m). 2) Route Novi to us-west-1 for demo if they accept latency. 3) If Sales confirms paid override, infra to attempt manual node add (prov request INF-2026-571) — ETA 3-4h. 4) Postmortem if autoscaler blocked by global quota.

Evan (Sales): Novi confirmed: they'd prefer guaranteed GPUs. They've approved charge for +3 A10g for 12h. Please prioritize provisioning.

Provisioning Bot: Received manual capacity increase request INF-2026-571. Cloud quota check: account has spare vCPU/GPU quota in us-west-2 = 0. Requesting org-level quota increase from cloud provider.

Priya (Eng Oncall): I'll kick off the cross-region fallback config in parallel so demo can run if provisioning stalls.

Jonas (SRE): Noted. I've applied the admission_control soft caps to the pool and reduced concurrency to 20 for Novi. Monitoring the queue.

ThetaBot: :white_check_mark: Admission control update applied. Novi queue length reduced from 18 -> 6 in 90s.

Maria (Support): Thank you team — Sales confirmed payment, infra has requested provider quota increase. For now we've put the soft caps and enabled us-west-1 fallback. I'll keep Novi updated and close this thread after provisioning outcome.

Evan (Sales): Thanks all. Please attach post-incident notes to INF-2026-571 once resolved so we can include SLA impacts in the invoice.

Jonas (SRE): Will do, and I'll add recommended autoscaler config to prevent scale_block next time (increase org quota alerting + pre-warm pool).

Maria (Support): Closing for now — temporary override requested; follow-up ticket INF-2026-571. :white_check_mark:
